project.name: Rachmat Nahyadi — Thunderline Legal Portfolio
project.audience: Perekrut hukum, firma hukum, instansi, dan bagian legal korporasi
project.primaryTask: Memverifikasi pendidikan, keterampilan, pengalaman legal assistant, serta menghubungi Rachmat
project.thesis: This website is an energized legal field record because Rachmat can demonstrate research, legal documentation, and legal aid work, which prospective employers need to verify quickly.

concepts.name: Evidence index
concepts.readingGrammar: Data-led fact scan and aligned evidence metadata
concepts.media: Authentic photos as subordinate source records
concepts.tradeoff: Dense source index risks flattening narrative

concepts.name: Legal dossier
concepts.readingGrammar: Archive-folder annotations and legal record captions
concepts.media: Authentic documentary photographs as record covers
concepts.tradeoff: Artificial legal theatre could feel like fabricated casework

concepts.name: Chronological charge
concepts.readingGrammar: Dates lead every reading line; role names anchored to chronology
concepts.tradeoff: Limited internship count yields too-short timeline

concepts.name: Field record
concepts.readingGrammar: Massive condensed name contrasts with concise reading columns and source-backed detail
concepts.media: Night portrait hero plus real books/graduation photos
concepts.interaction: Three-second plasma background with pause and reduced-motion poster fallback
concepts.tradeoff: Visual intensity must not obscure factual reading

concepts.name: Research notebook
concepts.readingGrammar: Extended running paragraphs and marginal research notes
concepts.tradeoff: No original research papers attached; risks invented examples

concepts.name: Recruiter comparison
concepts.readingGrammar: Task-oriented matrix of source facts and dates
concepts.media: Photos as small profile evidence only
concepts.interaction: Filter or focus across capability categories
concepts.tradeoff: May resemble an applicant tracking interface

concepts.name: Editorial photo essay
concepts.readingGrammar: Photo captions lead with tightly edited factual text
concepts.media: Three authentic photos form core narrative

selection.reason: Field record prioritizes verified legal facts and accessible contact while giving Rachmat a distinctive identity anchored in supplied photos.

signature.description: A genuine blue/violet 3-second plasma loop behind an evidence-led name-first legal portrait.
signature.benefit: Memorable first impression while keeping recruitment facts visible and actionable.
signature.fallback: Static plasma still, semantic HTML and user-facing pause control.

decisions.choice: Keep documented practice as evidence rows rather than fabricated projects.
decisions.benefit: Recruiters can verify actual work without fictional case results.

decisions.choice: Use the client's three photos within distinct narrative moments.
decisions.tradeoff: Photography composition and mobile crops require individual review.

avoid.pattern: Centered generic SaaS hero followed by three service cards
avoid.reason: It obscures the client's law experience and repeats interchangeable structure.

avoid.pattern: Invented case wins or portfolio projects
avoid.reason: CV only supports internship tasks, not case outcomes.

comparison.note: Prior Lazarus visual materials were considered at planning level; no validated full-page structural screenshots are available for a source-bound side-by-side comparison.

typography.reason: Name-first editorial grammar gives personal identity immediate recognition, with genuine qualifications immediately available.
typography.fontRights: Barlow Condensed and IBM Plex families under SIL OFL via Google Fonts; fallback system families, no redistributed font binaries.
typography.fallback: Impact/Arial Narrow and Arial/system sans; all information remains HTML and responsive.

voice.language: Bahasa Indonesia dengan sedikit label editorial bahasa Inggris
voice.pronouns: Orang ketiga dan editorial netral; tidak ada kutipan orang pertama tanpa persetujuan
voice.rationale: CV emphasizes legal research, discipline, communication and verified internships.

samples.copy: Riset yang cermat. Dokumen yang tertata. Pendekatan hukum yang berpijak pada detail.
Menyusun draf dokumen hukum, melakukan riset peraturan, mengelola data, dan mengorganisasi arsip berkas perkara.

mobile.readingOrder: Identity → degree and IPK → legal capabilities → experience timeline → real photo narratives → CV-listed portfolio link → contacts
mobile.illustrationPolicy: Authentic photos preserve subject crop; plasma video must remain behind readable text.
mobile.motionFallback: Pause control; prefers-reduced-motion uses static poster.
riskAreas: Long legal organizations and email wrapping
